title: Getting Space Right: Agentic Rewards for Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14852v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for spatial text-to-image generation, but existing work largely focuses on policy optimization, assuming accurate rewards and effective online rollouts. We observe in-domain gains with out-of-domain degradation, exposing two limitations: unreliable spatial rewards in open-world settings and rollouts lacking basic-to-complex progression. We propose a curriculum-guided RL framework. First, we introduce SpatialCritic, an agentic reward model equipped with a spatial perception harness that combines reusable verification guidance with specialized vision tools. We then construct spatial preference datasets through targeted counterfactual perturbations and perform agent-harness alignment to improve tool selection and evidence integration efficiently. Second, curriculum learning organizes shared foundational capabilities and their compositional dependencies in a capability graph for mastery-guided rollo

translated_title: 正确把握空间：面向图像生成的智能体式奖励
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）在空间文本到图像生成方面前景可期，但现有工作大多聚焦于策略优化，并假设奖励准确且在线 rollout 有效。我们观察到域内收益伴随域外性能退化，这暴露了两个局限：开放世界场景中空间奖励不可靠，以及 rollout 缺乏从基础到复杂的渐进过程。我们提出了一个课程引导的 RL 框架。首先，我们引入 SpatialCritic，一个配备空间感知装置的智能体奖励模型，该装置将可复用的验证指导与专用视觉工具相结合；随后，我们通过有针对性的反事实扰动构建空间偏好数据集，并执行智能体-装置对齐，以高效改进工具选择与证据整合。其次，课程学习在一个能力图中组织共享的基础能力及其组合依赖关系，以进行掌握引导的 rollout 训练。
tldr: 提出课程引导的强化学习框架与智能体式奖励模型 SpatialCritic，通过空间感知装置、反事实扰动构建偏好数据与智能体-装置对齐，解决了空间文生图中开放世界空间奖励不可靠和 rollout 缺乏由基础到复杂渐进的问题，实现域内外性能同步提升。
